meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed exact-name comparison selection and runtime guidance: optional show/show me presentation suffix preserves the same verified identities, while the anchored grammar still rejects an unresolved third product. Public scope, trace storage, schemas and golden expectations are unchanged.

auth.review_note: Reviewed owner-only capability policy and unchanged authentication routes against the shared backend guidance. Browser claims cannot grant commerce_report; guest/customer denial and foreign-owner saved evidence denial are covered. Existing auth references remain accurate.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed product, stock, customer and coupon projections against existing StoreStats calculations. Documented line-count versus order-count, allocated refunds, within-period anonymous customer bands, missing customer keys and current status without quantities. Canonical commerce services and normal payment/order flows are unchanged.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Cross-reviewed canonical HTTP discovery and official product URLs against WebMCP/deployment guidance. Native CI exercised shared STDIO projection and exposed two old full-object assertions; updated their explicit expected official URLs, added ordered gallery URL and foreign-image exclusion checks, retained strict equality and all scope/transport assertions. The production curl probe remains bounded and read-only.

google-tags.review_note: Inspected the public layout diff and existing Google tag/integration guidance. The new JSON_HEX encoded product origin is after the existing tag renderer and does not change analytics IDs, reporting grants, destinations or consent handling.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed the public discovery controller no-store JSON 400/503 boundary and actual front-controller invalid-origin tests against request-failure and deployment guidance. Normal storefront HTML remains available; curl and browser HTTP failures remain visible.

interface.review_note: Reviewed the layout fallback and product-adapter validation against Design and frontend/admin UI boundaries. Invalid connector origin preserves ordinary storefront rendering; optional absolute URLs must match the configured origin and safe existing paths. Native A2UI relative navigation and private scopes remain intact.

mail.review_note: Reviewed AdminController changes limited to Enterprise capabilities and follow-up report context. No mail scheduling, transport, inbox or template behavior changes; existing email setup and backend references remain accurate.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared shared public product URL fields and the updated shop guide with private STDIO grants and integration controls. Official absolute URLs add no private MCP grant, account session or reporting tool.

media.review_note: Reviewed the admin UI skill addition against media deletion verification and architecture. Card images remain approved public raster paths, and disclosures change local visibility only; upload, deletion, ownership and stale-media safeguards are unchanged.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the new exact public discovery route and safely encoded layout origin with the fixed operator/public help references. Discovery returns no owner guide or actor records; existing Help authorization and navigation remain accurate.

public-mcp.review_note: Reviewed actual-registry discovery, protocol headers and executable list/contact examples, canonical HTTPS origin/path/image parity, module gates and exact-result cards against public MCP, shop and A2UI guidance. Both official SDK profiles and focused PHP/router tests passed; live curl checks are separately gated after deployment.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Compared the CI syntax check, post-SHA real curl probe and safe llms diagnostic headers with deployment and Git/documentation workflow guidance. Read-only acceptance preserves failures, uses no retry bypass, and does not close unresolved host 429 issues. Regenerated maps and indexes from the actual new route.
